setup.zh: 河伯没走。他悬在漳水正中，踩着两条龙，低头看着你的胸口：「……你身上，有青丘的味道。」河心底下，有一样东西在一明一暗地呼吸。
setup.en: The River Lord has not gone. He hangs over the middle of the Zhang on his two dragons, looking down at your chest: "…You smell of Qingqiu." Deep in mid-river, something breathes, light and dark, light and dark.

recap.zh: 河伯原是冰夷；他守了两千年的东西，在河心的坑底，上头压着洛书之封。你潜下去，数错了一回，又改了过来。
recap.en: The River Lord was Bingyi; what he had guarded for two thousand years lay at the bottom of the pit mid-river, under the Luo seal. You dived, counted wrong once, and set it right.

en: A light at the bottom of the pit: light, dark.

story.zh:
河伯看着他们，看了很久很久，这才开口。他的声音不大，却震得整条漳水都在嗡嗡作响：「……谁。谁说我要娶媳妇的？」

阿禾仰着头看他，嘴唇冻得发紫，声音却一点不抖：「她欠的账，还没还。人淹死了，账就烂了。」

河伯没走。他悬在漳水正中，踩着两条龙，低头看着小满——说得准些，是看着他胸口。他开口的时候，嘴唇却没有动，那声音是从小满脚底下的水里漫上来的，一个字一个字，只往他一个人耳朵里钻：「……你身上，有青丘的味道。」

小满压着嗓子问道：「冯夷？他不叫河伯？」银月没好气地道：「本名冰夷。冯夷，是你们凡人念岔了的；『河伯』，是你们凡人给他起的官名。他家原在极北的从极之渊，深三百仞，住得好好的——两千年前，不知替谁看起了门，看到这烂泥塘里来了。」

河伯道：「两千年前，有人托我守它。她说，会有人来拿。拿的人，身上有青丘的味道。」顿了一顿，又道：「光有味道不够。方才那两条龙，是替她问你的。」

等岸上的人散尽，日头偏西，小满才下了水。
story.en:
The River Lord looked at them for a long, long time before he spoke. His voice was not loud, yet it set the whole Zhang humming: "…Who. Who said I wanted a wife?"

A-He looked up at him, lips blue with cold, her voice not shaking at all: "She hasn't paid what she owes. If she drowns, the debt goes bad."

The River Lord did not go. He hung over the middle of the Zhang on his two dragons, looking down at Xiaoman — at his chest, to be exact. When he spoke his lips did not move; the voice welled up from the water under Xiaoman's feet, word by word, into his ears alone: "…You smell of Qingqiu."

Xiaoman asked under his breath: "Fengyi? He isn't the River Lord?" Silver Moon said sourly: "His name is Bingyi. Fengyi is how you mortals garbled it; 'River Lord' is the title you mortals gave him. His home was far in the north, in the Abyss of Congji, three hundred fathoms deep, and he lived there well enough — two thousand years ago he took up keeping someone's door, and kept it all the way into this mud pond."

The River Lord said: "Two thousand years ago someone asked me to guard it. She said someone would come for it. The one who came would smell of Qingqiu." He paused, then said: "The smell alone is not enough. Those two dragons just now — they were asking you on her behalf."

Only when the bank had emptied and the sun leaned west did Xiaoman go into the water.

label.en: Read the seal · Fill the heart

exits.means: reads the seal, answers what belongs in the middle square

story.zh:
便在这时，胸口的木牌，微微一热。只一点点，像冬夜里揣在怀里的一颗炭星。没有声音，只那么热了一下，便又凉了。

三的底下，是八。他伸手去摸左边那一只「足」上的石头，一个点一个点地数：一，二，三，四，五，六。六。他放反了。

他把左边那块六个点的拿起来，和右边那块八个点的，对调了过来。左八，右六。

然后他拿起最后那块石头，五个点的，按进了正中那一格——第九格。

这一回，它进去了。只听得「咔」的一声轻响，那声音不大，他在水底下却听得清清楚楚，便如沈家那扇装歪了的门，终于给人扶正了，落进了门臼里。
story.en:
Just then the token at his chest grew faintly warm. Only a little, like an ember carried inside your coat on a winter night. No voice — just that one warmth, and then it was cool again.

Under three, eight. He reached for the stone on the left foot and counted it dot by dot: one, two, three, four, five, six. Six. He had them the wrong way round.

He took up the six-dot stone on the left and swapped it with the eight-dot stone on the right. Eight left, six right.

Then he took the last stone, the five-dot one, and pressed it into the middle square — the ninth.

This time it went in. There was a soft click — not loud, but under the water he heard it clearly — like the Shen family's crooked door finally set straight and dropped into its socket.

exits.means: tries to break, lift or pry the slab by force

text.zh: 石板纹丝不动。九个数在你掌下微微发烫。
text.en: The slab does not move. The nine numbers grow warm under your palm.
